nodes.label: icons.svg SVG Symbol Sprite
nodes.rationale: Single SVG sprite of <symbol> definitions referenced via <use href> to avoid multiple icon requests; appears to be the Vite starter template sprite (social/docs links).

nodes.label: SVG Symbol Sprite Pattern
nodes.rationale: Brand icons use solid fill #08060d; UI icons (documentation, social) use stroke #aa3bff accent, indicating two icon styles in one sprite.

nodes.label: Meditation / Wellness Brand Imagery
nodes.rationale: Warm orange/lavender sunset palette and serene yoga pose reinforce the Yogella yoga app identity at the entry point (sign-in/sign-up).

nodes.label: Auth Background (Desktop) - Seaside Sunset Meditation
nodes.rationale: Wide landscape photo (woman meditating cross-legged on coastal rock at sunset, ocean horizon) used as desktop background for authentication screens; subject sits left-of-center leaving open sky/sea on the right for overlaying a login form, conveying calm wellness brand tone.

nodes.label: Auth Background (Mobile) Image
nodes.rationale: Tall portrait photo (woman meditating cross-legged on a seaside rock at sunset, warm pastel sky, neutral beige activewear) used as the mobile backdrop for the auth screens; the calm, wellness mood sets the brand tone for the yoga app, and the portrait crop with open sky in the upper half leaves room to overlay login/signup forms.

nodes.label: Auth Screen Full-Bleed Background Layout
nodes.rationale: Separate desktop variant (wide 16:9 crop, WebP for size) implies responsive art direction with a distinct mobile background asset.

nodes.label: Mobile Auth Screen Background
nodes.rationale: A separate mobile-specific asset (portrait aspect ratio, WebP for small size) implies a responsive art-direction pattern, likely paired with a desktop auth background variant.

nodes.label: Coolify (Traefik) deployment
nodes.rationale: Dockerfile build pack, port 3000, /api/health healthcheck, persistent volume /app/uploads; trust proxy so secure cookies work behind HTTPS.

nodes.label: DATABASE_URL (pgBouncer 6543) / DIRECT_URL (session pooler 5432)
nodes.rationale: Prisma migrates via direct/session connection and runs via transaction pooler; ?pgbouncer=true required; no connection_limit=1 since long-running process; session pooler chosen for IPv4 reachability.

nodes.label: prisma migrate deploy entrypoint
nodes.rationale: Schema managed by Prisma migrations, applied at every container start; migrations only add to Supabase schema; no seed.

nodes.label: Local-disk video uploads (server/src/lib/upload.ts)
nodes.rationale: Volume suffices for one instance; multi-replica requires Supabase Storage or S3, upload.ts is the only change point.

nodes.label: WEB_ORIGIN env var
nodes.rationale: Allowed CORS origin and Stripe checkout return URL; comma-separated list allowed.

nodes.label: Program model (isRoutine flag)
nodes.rationale: Routines and Programmes share one model since both are a titled, ordered list of course sessions.

nodes.label: Stripe subscription billing
nodes.rationale: Without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY checkout/portal return 503 rather than failing silently; falls back to inline price_data without price IDs.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth sessions (httpOnly cookies, JWKS ES256 verification)
nodes.norm_label: supabase auth sessions (httponly cookies, jwks es256 verification)

nodes.label: Prisma schema mapping onto pre-existing Supabase tables
nodes.norm_label: prisma schema mapping onto pre-existing supabase tables
nodes.rationale: Universe->categories, Course->videos, WatchProgress->watch_history; hand-written SQL migrations because prisma migrate dev lacks auth schema in shadow DB.

nodes.label: web/ - React + TypeScript + Vite mobile-first app (12 screens)
nodes.norm_label: web/ - react + typescript + vite mobile-first app (12 screens)
nodes.rationale: Adds Login/Register screens since the prototype had no real auth; drops fake phone bezel for plain responsive layout.

nodes.label: Claude Design handoff bundle
nodes.rationale: Prototypes are HTML/CSS/JS to be recreated pixel-perfectly in target tech; chat transcripts carry intent.

nodes.label: chat1.md - Yoga et Meditation App design transcript
nodes.norm_label: chat1.md - yoga et meditation app design transcript

nodes.label: Organic design system guide
nodes.rationale: Warm, rounded, playful: cream/sand ground, terracotta accent, sage second accent, Caprasimo over Figtree, 16px radii, washed photos; all values from CSS tokens.

nodes.label: npm ci --include=dev build fix
nodes.rationale: Coolify injects NODE_ENV=production at build, so npm ci would skip typescript/vite devDependencies.

nodes.label: API-side authorization (postgres role bypasses RLS)
nodes.rationale: Authorization done by API via Supabase Auth session + profiles.is_admin; inherited RLS policies protect PostgREST; new tables (plans, app_settings, experts) have RLS enabled without policy.

nodes.label: Single Docker image (API + uploads + React build)
nodes.norm_label: single docker image (api + uploads + react build)
nodes.rationale: One service, one domain: no CORS and same-site session cookies.

nodes.label: Real persisted state replacing prototype simulation
nodes.norm_label: real persisted state replacing prototype simulation
nodes.rationale: Prototype simulated subscription, admin CRUD and activity in memory; now Postgres via Prisma, real auth, real Stripe, watch-progress rows drive Ma pratique stats.

nodes.label: OKLCH 100-900 tonal ramps
nodes.rationale: Shared perceptual lightness so same step has same visual weight; accent-to-ground only 3:1 so body text uses accent-700.
